groups.name: memory-strings
groups.contract: Bounded memory/string operations on caller-owned live ranges; no allocation, hidden libc, or sleep.

groups.name: allocation
groups.contract: Checked size/alignment and GFP behavior, zeroing where requested, NULL on exhaustion, exact object lifetime and no free while mapped.

groups.name: atomics-bitmaps
groups.contract: Typed atomic/once/acquire/release and bitmap transitions with ordering, width/range validation and no scheduling.
groups.test: linux.driver_atomics (synthetic C; not original driver execution)

groups.name: ordering
groups.contract: CPU and coherent-DMA ordering are distinct contracts; reuse native fences only after checking selected x86 semantics.

groups.name: irq-spinlocks
groups.contract: Stable lock identity, owner checks, exact saved IF/guard accounting and no sleep or switch while held.

groups.name: sleeping-lifecycle-locks
groups.contract: Real sleeping mutex/lifecycle exclusion; cancellation cannot await a callback needing the caller's held lock.

groups.name: busy-delays
groups.contract: Calibrated bounded busy delay, not completion signalling or timer-delivery-count time.

groups.name: sleeping-delays
groups.contract: Suspend real kernel stacks with elapsed-time deadlines; reject IRQ/deferred-atomic contexts.

groups.name: interruptible-control-sleep
groups.contract: Optional ethtool diagnostic path needs genuine remaining-time/interrupt semantics, or explicit diagnostic rejection; never return fake success.

groups.name: elapsed-jiffies
groups.contract: Monotonic elapsed-time jiffies and wrap-safe comparisons, published without torn reads.

groups.name: work-lifetime
groups.contract: Prebound stable work identities, deduplicated immediate/delayed enqueue, requeue and synchronous cancellation; IRQ only enqueues.

groups.name: irq-registration
groups.contract: Owned route plus C handler/dev_id, one supported source, no pre-read of ICR, synchronize/drain before retiring callback backing.
groups.test: linux.driver_irq (real QEMU IRQ; synthetic C handler)

groups.name: napi-control
groups.contract: Enable/disable/join are lifecycle operations; IRQ schedule-prep/enqueue never polls inline; budgets, completion and reschedule are real state.

groups.name: pci-binding-resources
groups.contract: Original registration/probe/remove order, owned regions/config state and stable device/private association; enabling master before ioremap must be supported.

groups.name: alternate-pci-quirks
groups.contract: MWI/PCI-X paths retained by source; audit reachability for 82540EM and enforce alternate-device rejection, not fabricated config values.
groups.test: linux.driver_allocation (MWI readback failure); alternate PCI-X rejected

groups.name: power-error-state
groups.contract: Actual device/system state or explicit unsupported PM/error-control boundary; retained shutdown/error callbacks do not establish PM support.

groups.name: owned-mmio
groups.contract: Map/unmap only in lifecycle context; volatile accesses authorized by live owned range and context, with posted-write ordering and no stolen ICR read.

groups.name: alternate-io
groups.contract: Unsupported I/O/physical translation for other MACs must fail diagnostically if reached; selected QEMU MMIO path must not depend on them.

groups.name: coherent-rings
groups.contract: Whole backing range mask/alignment/zeroing, raw protocol-shared descriptor memory, and exact coherent-free after relevant engine/callback quiescence.

groups.name: streaming-linear
groups.contract: Device/direction/range-bound pins, mapping-error propagation, CPU/device sync and exact unmap after per-region completion or safe aborted submission.

groups.name: streaming-fragment
groups.contract: Typed page/fragment map interfaces are retained; reject fragmented/jumbo input before driver entry until independently implemented.

groups.name: net-device-lifecycle
groups.contract: Owned netdev/private backing, registered original ops, feature/link/running state, stable address iterators and exact unregister/free.

groups.name: queue-ownership
groups.contract: Real stop/wake/BUSY state and TX byte/packet accounting; original cleanup drives completion, not skb free or a native descriptor loop alone.

groups.name: linear-skb
groups.contract: Live head/data/tail/length/shared-info ownership, checked padding/trimming, allocation failure and exactly-once consumption; metadata helpers inspect actual values.

groups.name: rx-fragment-handoff
groups.contract: RX fragment backing is required even for linear profile; retain mappings/backing through copybreak or build-skb handoff and replenish without double free.

groups.name: ethernet-ingress
groups.contract: Real address validation/copy, L2 header/protocol/FCS handling and owned native ingress transfer; no claim of full IP/GRO stack.

groups.name: jumbo-fragments
groups.contract: Unselected jumbo/fragment paths retain references; reject profile violations and diagnose any unimplemented reached operation.

groups.name: offload-headers
groups.contract: No GSO/partial-checksum/VLAN injection in initial profile; typed helpers need real header/range behavior if exposed, never constant feature answers.

groups.name: ethtool-controls
groups.contract: Original ops installation remains intact; optional requests need genuine conversion/time-stamp capability or an explicit unsupported boundary.

groups.name: diagnostics-scalars
groups.contract: Allocation-free bounded diagnostics, actual message-level/rate state, BUG/WARN outcomes, prefetch and endian/scalar semantics; no silent default logging.
groups.test: linux.driver_atomics plus exact host-checked format output

outl.contract: 82540 reset unconditionally uses owned PCI I/O BAR index/data writes. Validate the bound non-legacy 64-byte BAR and CTRL reset pair; gate DMA/callback lifetime before forwarding reset. Other port accesses are rejected.

napi_free_frags.contract: Unconditional RX ring cleanup calls this even at MTU 1500; inspect and release real NAPI fragment state, including an empty state, rather than treating it as an unsupported jumbo-only operation.
